blocks.prompt: 11 Zaid is organizing a sports competition with 8 teams. Every team plays against every other team exactly once. How many matches will be played in total? Use Pascal's triangle to solve this.
blocks.explanation:
Har match 8 teams mein se 2 teams chun-ne se banta hai, aur un do teams ki tarteeb (order) se farq nahi parta.
Is liye matches ki tadaad \({}^{8}C_{2}\) hai, jo hum Pascal's triangle ki row 8 se parhenge.
Plan: row 8 banayein (ya Question 7 se lein), position 2 parhein, aur seedhi ginti se tasdeeq karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 teams; har do teams aapas mein sirf ek dafa khelti hain.
Humein find karna hai: kul matches.
Tareeqa: Ek match = 8 mein se 2 teams ka intikhab (combination), is liye ginti \({}^{8}C_{2}\) hai. Pascal's triangle se binomial coefficients factorial ke bagair mil jate hain, aur sawal yehi tareeqa maangta hai.

Combination kyun
\[\text{matches} = {}^{8}C_{2}\]
Kyun: 'Team A vs Team B' aur 'Team B vs Team A' ek hi match hai. Jab tarteeb se farq na pare to combination lagta hai, permutation nahi.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{8}P_{2} = 56\) le lena aam ghalti hai; us mein har match do dafa gina jata hai.

Pascal's triangle ki row 8
\[1\ \ 8\ \ 28\ \ 56\ \ 70\ \ 56\ \ 28\ \ 8\ \ 1\]
Kyun: Row 7 (1, 7, 21, 35, 35, 21, 7, 1) ke saath wale numbers jama kiye: \(1 + 7 = 8\), \(7 + 21 = 28\), \(21 + 35 = 56\), \(35 + 35 = 70\), aur baqi symmetry se. Poora triangle row 0 se Question 7 mein bana hua hai; agar yaad na ho to wahan se dobara bana lein, sirf jama karna hai.

Position 2 parhein
\[{}^{8}C_{2} = 28\]
Kyun: 0 se ginti: position 0 par 1, position 1 par 8, position 2 par 28. Row ka number \(n = 8\) teams ki tadaad hai, aur position \(r = 2\) yeh hai ke ek match mein kitni teams chuni jati hain.
Dhyan dein: Row 7 parh lena bhi aam ghalti hai; rows bhi 0 se gini jati hain, is liye 8 teams ke liye woh row chahiye jo 1, 8, ... se shuru hoti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[7 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 28\]
\[\dfrac{8 \times 7}{2} = 28\]
Kyun: Pehli team 7 teams se khelti hai, doosri team baqi 6 nayi teams se (pehli se to khel chuki), teesri 5 se, aur isi tarah. Jama 28. Formula \(\frac{8 \cdot 7}{2}\) se bhi 28.
